mapper.sql: discrepancy_id, transfer_id, shipment_id, discrepancy_no, status, discrepancy_type, shipped_quantity, accepted_quantity, shortage_quantity, rejected_quantity, damaged_quantity, description, attachment_refs, responsible_party, resolution_decision, resolution_note, handled_by_user_id, handled_by_name, handled_time, version, create_by, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: insert into inv_transfer_discrepancy ( transfer_id, shipment_id, discrepancy_no, status, discrepancy_type, shipped_quantity, accepted_quantity, shortage_quantity, rejected_quantity, damaged_quantity, description, attachment_refs, version, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{transferId}, #{shipmentId}, #{discrepancyNo}, #{status}, #{discrepancyType}, #{shippedQuantity}, #{acceptedQuantity}, #{shortageQuantity}, #{rejectedQuantity}, #{damagedQuantity}, #{description}, #{attachmentRefs}, 0, #{createBy}, sysdate() )

insert into inv_transfer_discrepancy_detail ( discrepancy_id, transfer_detail_id, shipment_detail_id, item_type, item_id, item_code, item_name, shipped_quantity, accepted_quantity, shortage_quantity, rejected_quantity, damaged_quantity, resolution_quantity, note, attachment_refs ) values
(#{d.discrepancyId}, #{d.transferDetailId}, #{d.shipmentDetailId}, #{d.itemType}, #{d.itemId}, #{d.itemCode}, #{d.itemName}, #{d.shippedQuantity}, #{d.acceptedQuantity}, #{d.shortageQuantity}, #{d.rejectedQuantity}, #{d.damagedQuantity}, #{d.resolutionQuantity}, #{d.note}, #{d.attachmentRefs})
mapper.select: select from inv_transfer_discrepancy where discrepancy_id = #{discrepancyId} for update
select from inv_transfer_discrepancy where transfer_id = #{transferId} order by discrepancy_id

select disposition_id, discrepancy_id, discrepancy_detail_id, shipment_detail_id, category, decision, quantity, cost_price, amount, inventory_impact, source_location_dept_id, target_location_dept_id, responsible_party, note, attachment_refs, request_id, handled_by_user_id, handled_by_name, handled_time, version from inv_transfer_discrepancy_disposition where discrepancy_id = #{value} order by disposition_id
mapper.update: update inv_transfer_discrepancy set status = #{status}, resolution_decision = #{decision}, responsible_party = #{responsibleParty}, resolution_note = #{note}, handled_by_user_id = #{handledByUserId}, handled_by_name = #{handledByName}, handled_time = case when #{status} = 'RESOLVED' then sysdate() else handled_time end, version = version + 1, update_time = sysdate() where discrepancy_id = #{discrepancyId} and version = #{version} and status in ('OPEN', 'PENDING_QC')
